overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Tempo is a repeating alarm and productivity app for Android. Your privacy matters — Tempo is designed to work entirely on your device with no data leaving your phone.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.body: Tempo does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on external servers. There are no analytics, no tracking, no advertising SDKs, and no network requests to third-party services.

localStorage.title: Local Storage
localStorage.body: All data is stored locally on your device:
localStorage.item1: Rhythm configurations and alarm schedules (SQLite database)
localStorage.item2: User preferences and settings (MMKV key-value storage)

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: Tempo does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or data processing services. The app uses Android's built-in alarm and notification systems to deliver alerts.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.body: Tempo requests only the permissions necessary for alarm functionality:
permissions.item1: Exact alarms — to fire alarms at the scheduled time
permissions.item3: Full-screen intent — to show the alarm screen over the lock screen (Pulse intensity only)

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.body: Tempo is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect any information from children.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: If this privacy policy changes, the updated version will be posted on this page with a new date. Since Tempo collects no data, changes are unlikely.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this privacy policy? Reach out at tempo@guidotto.dev.
